matches.reviewNote: Qu’auraient-ils à dire asks what content the creatures would have available to say. The published qu’aurait bank is explicitly compound-tense auxiliary, qu’as asks about illness or possession, and the earlier qu’ai à faire de bank tests relationship; all were inspected and excluded as question banks. The global lexical avoir sense explicitly covers abstract as well as concrete possession, so this surface targets that existing sense under lem_avoir. The fused spelling does not create a tense-only sense or another lemma; que stays inside the exact token, and final import must not duplicate an interrogative component encounter. All middle prefixes form grammatical plural hypothetical questions, distinguished by have/buy/lose/make semantics. No earlier mastery is copied.
